     1→/**
     2→ * @file engine.ts
     3→ * @module @quilt/core
     4→ *
     5→ * =====================================================================
     6→ *  THE QUILT ENGINE — the reactive runtime
     7→ * =====================================================================
     8→ *
     9→ * This is the heart of Quilt. It holds the cell graph, tracks
    10→ * dependencies, propagates changes, and exposes the universal API:
    11→ * `get`, `set`, `call`, `push`, `subscribe`.
    12→ *
    13→ * Everything else (CLI, MCP, TUI, Web) is a view onto this engine.
    14→ * If you understand this file, you understand the system.
    15→ *
    16→ * =====================================================================
    17→ *  ROLE IN THE SYSTEM
    18→ * =====================================================================
    19→ *
    20→ *     types.ts       ◄── Cell, CellDef, CellId, CellValue, CallerContext
    21→ *     context.ts     ◄── extendContext, contextKey
    22→ *     cells/*.ts     ◄── evaluateValue, evaluateFormula, evaluateApi,
    23→ *                       evaluateProgram, evaluateRouter, fireListener,
    24→ *                       makeSensorValue, makeIoValue
    25→ *        ▲
    26→ *        │ imports
    27→ *        │
    28→ *     engine.ts      ◄── THIS FILE: QuiltEngine (the runtime)
    29→ *        ▲
    30→ *        │ imports
    31→ *        │
    32→ *     parser.ts      (uses engine.loadSheet to install parsed cells)
    33→ *     mcp/server.ts  (calls engine.get/call/subscribe for MCP tools)
    34→ *     cli/index.ts   (calls engine.get/set/loadSheet for commands)
    35→ *
    36→ * The engine implements `ProgramRuntime` so that program cells can
    37→ * call back into the runtime (read, write, call other cells). This
    38→ * is the "user code can compose with the runtime" hook.
    39→ *
    40→ * =====================================================================
    41→ *  THE LIFECYCLE OF A CELL
    42→ * =====================================================================
    43→ *
    44→ *   1. loadSheet(sheet) — define cells, build dependency graph
    45→ *      For each CellDef, create a Cell with empty value.
    46→ *      For formulas, scan the expression and add dep edges.
    47→ *      For others, use the declared `deps` field.
    48→ *
    49→ *   2. get(id, ctx) — pull a cell's value, computing if needed
    50→ *      Pure cells (value, formula): recompute on demand.
    51→ *      Effectful cells (api, program, router): de-duped, cached.
    52→ *      Push-based cells (sensor, io, listener): return current.
    53→ *
    54→ *   3. set(id, value, ctx) — write a value, propagate changes
    55→ *      Update the cell, mark dependents as stale,
    56→ *      notify subscribers, fire listeners.
    57→ *
    58→ *   4. call(id, input, ctx) — invoke a cell as a capability
    59→ *      Same as get for pure cells. For effectful, pass input.
    60→ *
    61→ *   5. push(id, data) — push a value into a sensor or IO cell
    62→ *      External adapters call this. Triggers downstream.
    63→ *
    64→ * =====================================================================
    65→ *  PROPAGATION ALGORITHM
    66→ * =====================================================================
    67→ *
    68→ * When a cell's value changes (via set or push), the engine walks
    69→ * the dependent graph depth-first:
    70→ *
    71→ *   1. Mark each formula/value dependent as 'stale' and clear its cache
    72→ *   2. Recurse into their dependents
    73→ *   3. For each listener dependent, check its condition and fire
    74→ *   4. Notify external subscribers
    75→ *
    76→ * Pure cells are not auto-recomputed; they recompute lazily on the
    77→ * next get(). Effectful cells are NEVER auto-recomputed by upstream
    78→ * changes — they must be called explicitly.
    79→ *
    80→ * =====================================================================
    81→ *  CACHING STRATEGY
    82→ * =====================================================================
    83→ *
    84→ * Per-context memoization: same cell + same caller context (by
    85→ * row/column/identity/tags) → same cached value.
    86→ *
    87→ *   - value cells: no cache needed (always O(1))
    88→ *   - formula cells: cache the result by contextKey
    89→ *   - api/program/router cells: cache the result by contextKey
    90→ *   - sensor/io/listener cells: not cached (push-based)
    91→ *
    92→ * Cache is invalidated:
    93→ *   - On set (to the same cell)
    94→ *   - On propagation (to formula dependents)
    95→ *   - Never on context change (we cache per context, not per cell)
    96→ *
    97→ * =====================================================================
    98→ */
    99→import { emptyContext, extendContext, contextKey, callKey } from './context.js';
   100→import { evaluateValue } from './cells/value.js';
   101→import { evaluateFormula } from './cells/formula.js';
   102→import { evaluateApi } from './cells/api.js';
   103→import { evaluateProgram } from './cells/program.js';
   104→import { evaluateRouter } from './cells/router.js';
   105→import { fireListener } from './cells/listener.js';
   106→import { makeSensorValue } from './cells/sensor.js';
   107→import { makeIoValue } from './cells/io.js';
   108→import { evaluateAI } from './cells/ai.js';
   109→const defaultOptions = {
   110→    maxConcurrency: 16,
   111→    tracing: false,
   112→    eager: false,
   113→};
   114→/**
   115→ * The Quilt reactive runtime. One instance per "session" or "agent"
   116→ * or "deployment". Holds the cell graph and provides the universal
   117→ * API.
   118→ */
   119→export class QuiltEngine {
   120→    id;
   121→    cells = new Map();
   122→    subscriptions = new Map();
   123→    inflight = new Map();
   124→    traces = [];
   125→    options;
   126→    subscriptionCounter = 0;
   127→    constructor(id = 'default', options = {}) {
   128→        this.id = id;
   129→        const { ai, ...rest } = options;
   130→        this.options = { ...defaultOptions, ...rest, ai };
   131→    }
   132→    // ===========================================================================
   133→    // SHEET LIFECYCLE
   134→    // ===========================================================================
   135→    /**
   136→     * Load a sheet definition into the engine. Resets all cell state.
   137→     *
   138→     * Steps:
   139→     *   1. Clear existing cells, in-flight evaluations, traces
   140→     *   2. For each CellDef, create a Cell instance
   141→     *   3. Build dependency edges (auto-detect for formulas, declared for others)
   142→     *   4. Index dependents (reverse lookup)
   143→     *
   144→     * After loadSheet, the engine is ready to answer get/set/call.
   145→     * No values are computed until something asks for them (pull-based).
   146→     */
   147→    loadSheet(sheet) {
   148→        this.cells.clear();
   149→        this.inflight.clear();
   150→        this.traces = [];
   151→        for (const def of sheet.cells) {
   152→            this.defineCell(def);
   153→        }
   154→        // Build dependency edges. For formulas, auto-detect by scanning
   155→        // the expression. For everything else, use the declared `deps`.
   156→        for (const cell of this.cells.values()) {
   157→            if (cell.def.kind === 'formula' || cell.def.kind === 'ai') {
   158→                this.autoDetectDeps(cell);
   159→            }
   160→            // PLAY-TEST FIX: wire listener `watch` lists into the graph.
   161→            // Without this edge, propagate() never reaches listener cells and
   162→            // fireListener is dead code for sheets authored per the documented
   163→            // schema (watch/condition/action with no deps).
   164→            if (cell.def.kind === 'listener') {
   165→                for (const w of cell.def.watch ?? []) {
   166→                    this.addDep(cell.id, w);
   167→                }
   168→            }
   169→            for (const dep of cell.def.deps ?? []) {
   170→                this.addDep(cell.id, dep);
   171→            }
   172→        }
   173→    }
   174→    /**
   175→     * Define a single cell. Adds it to the graph.
   176→     *
   177→     * Throws if a cell with the same id already exists. Use this for
   178→     * static sheets (via loadSheet) or for one-off cells in tests.
   179→     * For dynamic registration (e.g. agents defining cells at runtime),
   180→     * use `register()`.
   181→     */
   182→    defineCell(def) {
   183→        if (this.cells.has(def.id)) {
   184→            throw new Error(`cell already defined: ${def.id}`);
   185→        }
   186→        // Seed the cell with its initial value. Value cells use
   187→        // `def.value`; sensor cells use `def.default` (if any) so
   188→        // demo sheets work without an adapter wired up.
   189→        let initial = { data: undefined, status: 'idle' };
   190→        if (def.value !== undefined) {
   191→            initial = { data: def.value, status: 'ready', computedAt: Date.now() };
   192→        }
   193→        else if (def.kind === 'sensor' && def.default !== undefined) {
   194→            initial = { data: def.default, status: 'ready', computedAt: Date.now() };
   195→        }
   196→        const cell = {
   197→            id: def.id,
   198→            def,
   199→            value: initial,
   200→            dependencies: new Set(),
   201→            dependents: new Set(),
   202→            contextCache: new Map(),
   203→        };
   204→        this.cells.set(def.id, cell);
   205→        return cell;
   206→    }
   207→    /**
   208→     * Register a new cell definition after load. Used for dynamic
   209→     * registration (e.g. sensors connecting, agents defining new tools).
   210→     *
   211→     * Unlike defineCell, this also builds dependency edges from the
   212→     * declared deps. (Formulas registered dynamically don't get
   213→     * auto-detected deps — declare them explicitly.)
   214→     */
   215→    register(def) {
   216→        const cell = this.defineCell(def);
   217→        if (def.kind === 'listener') {
   218→            for (const w of def.watch ?? []) {
   219→                this.addDep(def.id, w);
   220→            }
   221→        }
   222→        for (const dep of def.deps ?? []) {
   223→            this.addDep(def.id, dep);
   224→        }
   225→        return cell;
   226→    }
   227→    // ===========================================================================
   228→    // THE UNIVERSAL API: get, set, call
   229→    // ===========================================================================
   230→    /**
   231→     * Get a cell's value. Evaluates if needed.
   232→     *
   233→     * Dispatch by cell kind:
   234→     *   - value:   return the static value (no computation)
   235→     *   - formula: refresh deps, then evaluate
   236→     *   - api/program/router: de-dupe concurrent calls, evaluate
   237→     *   - sensor/io/listener: return the current pushed value
   238→     *
   239→     * Per-context memoization: same cell + same context → cached.
   240→     *
   241→     * @param id - the cell id
   242→     * @param ctx - the caller context (for routing and cache key)
   243→     * @returns the cell's value, or an error CellValue
   244→     */
   245→    async get(id, ctx = emptyContext()) {
   246→        const cell = this.cells.get(id);
   247→        if (!cell) {
   248→            return { data: undefined, status: 'error', error: { message: `no such cell: ${id}` } };
   249→        }
   250→        const fullCtx = extendContext(ctx, id);
   251→        switch (cell.def.kind) {
   252→            case 'value':
   253→                // PLAY-TEST FIX: return the LIVE cell value (seeded from def.value at
   254→                // load, updated by set()). Previously this called evaluateValue(),
   255→                // which reads cell.def.value — so engine.set() on a value cell was
   256→                // invisible to engine.get() (though downstream formulas DID see it,
   257→                // since they read cell.value.data). Classic stale-read asymmetry.
   258→                return cell.value.status === 'idle' ? evaluateValue(cell, fullCtx) : cell.value;
   259→            case 'formula': {
   260→                await this.refreshDeps(cell, fullCtx);
   261→                return evaluateFormula(cell, fullCtx, this.cells);
   262→            }
   263→            case 'api':
   264→            case 'program':
   265→            case 'router':
   266→            case 'ai': {
   267→                // PLAY-TEST PATCH 12: effectful cells are honest functions of the
   268→                // SHEET STATE, which contextKey cannot see. Serving them from the
   269→                // caller-aware cache froze a stateful sheet (the hold'em arbiter
   270→                // returned a stale verdict forever while match.seq read a stale 0
   271→                // from the read-cache). Default is now FRESH evaluation; declare
   272→                // `memo: true` on a pure cell to opt back into caching.
   273→                if (!cell.def.memo) {
   274→                    const value = await this.evaluateEffectful(cell, fullCtx, undefined);
   275→                    return value;
   276→                }
   277→                const key = contextKey(fullCtx);
   278→                const cached = cell.contextCache.get(key);
   279→                if (cached && cached.status === 'ready') {
   280→                    return cached;
   281→                }
   282→                const value2 = await this.evaluateEffectful(cell, fullCtx, undefined);
   283→                cell.contextCache.set(key, value2);
   284→                return value2;
   285→            }
   286→            case 'sensor':
   287→            case 'io':
   288→            case 'listener':
   289→                return cell.value;
   290→            default:
   291→                return { data: undefined, status: 'error', error: { message: `unknown kind: ${cell.def.kind}` } };
   292→        }
   293→    }
   294→    /**
   295→     * Set a cell's value. Triggers downstream recomputation.
   296→     *
   297→     * Steps:
   298→     *   1. Update the cell's value and invalidate its caller-aware cache
   299→     *   2. Notify external subscribers
   300→     *   3. Propagate to dependents (mark stale, fire listeners)
   301→     *
   302→     * Note: set only changes ONE cell. To update a transaction, you
   303→     * make multiple set calls. They're not atomic, but they are
   304→     * ordered — set is synchronous from the caller's perspective.
   305→     */
   306→    async set(id, value, ctx = emptyContext()) {
   307→        const cell = this.cells.get(id);
   308→        if (!cell) {
   309→            throw new Error(`no such cell: ${id}`);
   310→        }
   311→        const fullCtx = extendContext(ctx, id);
   312→        const prev = cell.value;
   313→        const newValue = {
   314→            data: value,
   315→            status: 'ready',
   316→            computedAt: Date.now(),
   317→        };
   318→        cell.value = newValue;
   319→        cell.contextCache.clear();
   320→        await this.notify(id, newValue, prev);
   321→        await this.propagate(id, fullCtx, undefined, prev);
   322→    }
   323→    /**
   324→     * Call a cell as a capability. Same as get for pure cells, but
   325→     * allows passing an `input` argument for effectful cells.
   326→     *
   327→     * USAGE:
   328→     *   const v = await engine.call('model.router', userInput, { row: 'boat-1' });
   329→     *   // The router receives userInput and routes based on the caller context.
   330→     */
   331→    async call(id, input, ctx = emptyContext()) {
   332→        const cell = this.cells.get(id);
   333→        if (!cell) {
   334→            return { data: undefined, status: 'error', error: { message: `no such cell: ${id}` } };
   335→        }
   336→        const fullCtx = extendContext(ctx, id);
   337→        if (cell.def.kind === 'value' || cell.def.kind === 'formula') {
   338→            return this.get(id, ctx);
   339→        }
   340→        if (cell.def.kind === 'sensor' || cell.def.kind === 'io' || cell.def.kind === 'listener') {
   341→            return cell.value;
   342→        }
   343→        // PLAY-TEST PATCH 10: include the call's input in the memo key.
   344→        // PLAY-TEST PATCH 12: ...and only memoize when the cell declares `memo: true`
   345→        // (a program is a function of its arguments AND of the sheet state).
   346→        const key = callKey(fullCtx, input);
   347→        if (cell.def.memo) {
   348→            const cached = cell.contextCache.get(key);
   349→            if (cached && cached.status === 'ready') {
   350→                return cached;
   351→            }
   352→        }
   353→        const inflightKey = `${id}|${key}`;
   354→        if (this.inflight.has(inflightKey)) {
   355→            return this.inflight.get(inflightKey);
   356→        }
   357→        const promise = this.evaluateEffectful(cell, fullCtx, input);
   358→        this.inflight.set(inflightKey, promise);
   359→        try {
   360→            const value = await promise;
   361→            if (cell.def.memo)
   362→                cell.contextCache.set(key, value);
   363→            return value;
   364→        }
   365→        finally {
   366→            this.inflight.delete(inflightKey);
   367→        }
   368→    }
   369→    /**
   370→     * Push a value into a sensor or IO cell. Triggers downstream.
   371→     *
   372→     * Called by external adapters (MQTT, Modbus, GPIO, MCP tools) when
   373→     * they have a new reading/event for the cell.
   374→     *
   375→     * Throws if the cell isn't a sensor or IO. Use set for value/formula.
   376→     */
   377→    async push(id, data, ctx = emptyContext()) {
   378→        const cell = this.cells.get(id);
   379→        if (!cell)
   380→            throw new Error(`no such cell: ${id}`);
   381→        if (cell.def.kind !== 'sensor' && cell.def.kind !== 'io') {
   382→            throw new Error(`cannot push to ${cell.def.kind} cell: ${id}`);
   383→        }
   384→        const newValue = cell.def.kind === 'sensor' ? makeSensorValue(data) : makeIoValue(data);
   385→        const prev = cell.value;
   386→        cell.value = newValue;
   387→        await this.notify(id, newValue, prev);
   388→        await this.propagate(id, extendContext(ctx, id), undefined, prev);
   389→    }
   390→    // ===========================================================================
   391→    // SUBSCRIPTIONS
   392→    // ===========================================================================
   393→    /**
   394→     * Subscribe to a cell's value changes. The callback fires every
   395→     * time the cell's value changes (and the optional filter returns
   396→     * true, if provided).
   397→     *
   398→     * Returns a subscription id. Pass it to `unsubscribe` to stop.
   399→     */
   400→    subscribe(cellId, callback, filter) {
   401→        const id = `sub-${++this.subscriptionCounter}`;
   402→        this.subscriptions.set(id, { id, cellId, callback, filter });
   403→        return id;
   404→    }
   405→    /**
   406→     * Stop a subscription. The callback will no longer fire.
   407→     */
   408→    unsubscribe(subscriptionId) {
   409→        this.subscriptions.delete(subscriptionId);
   410→    }
   411→    // ===========================================================================
   412→    // INTROSPECTION
   413→    // ===========================================================================
   414→    /**
   415→     * Get a cell instance by id. Returns undefined if no such cell.
   416→     * Use this to inspect a cell's dependencies, dependents, current value.
   417→     */
   418→    getCell(id) {
   419→        return this.cells.get(id);
   420→    }
   421→    /**
   422→     * List all cells, optionally filtered by kind.
   423→     */
   424→    listCells(kind) {
   425→        const all = Array.from(this.cells.values());
   426→        return kind ? all.filter(c => c.def.kind === kind) : all;
   427→    }
   428→    /**
   429→     * Get recent evaluation traces (for debugging, time-travel).
   430→     */
   431→    getTraces(limit = 100) {
   432→        return this.traces.slice(-limit);
   433→    }
   434→    /**
   435→     * Export all cell definitions as an array of CellDef. Used by
   436→     * `save` to serialize a runtime state back to YAML.
   437→     */
   438→    exportDefs() {
   439→        return Array.from(this.cells.values()).map(c => c.def);
   440→    }
   441→    // ===========================================================================
   442→    // INTERNAL: evaluation, propagation, dependencies
   443→    // ===========================================================================
   444→    /**
   445→     * Evaluate an effectful cell (api, program, router). Caches the
   446→     * result by context, notifies subscribers, and traces if enabled.
   447→     */
   448→    async evaluateEffectful(cell, ctx, input) {
   449→        const startedAt = Date.now();
   450→        let result;
   451→        if (cell.def.kind === 'api') {
   452→            result = await evaluateApi(cell, ctx, input);
   453→        }
   454→        else if (cell.def.kind === 'program') {
   455→            // PLAY-TEST PATCH 11: programs receive a context-bound runtime.
   456→            // Previously they got the raw engine, whose get/set/call default to
   457→            // emptyContext() — so a nested runtime.call from inside a program
   458→            // silently DROPPED the caller identity (tenant tier, tags, metadata).
   459→            // Same bug family as the router-delegation fix: per-tenant memoization
   460→            // collapsed to a single shared answer. Explicit contexts still win.
   461→            const boundRuntime = {
   462→                get: (id) => this.get(id, ctx),
   463→                set: (id, value) => this.set(id, value, ctx),
   464→                call: (id, i, c) => this.call(id, i, c ?? ctx),
   465→            };
   466→            result = await evaluateProgram(cell, ctx, input, boundRuntime);
   467→        }
   468→        else if (cell.def.kind === 'router') {
   469→            result = await evaluateRouter(cell, ctx, input, this);
   470→        }
   471→        else if (cell.def.kind === 'ai') {
   472→            if (!this.options.ai) {
   473→                result = { data: null, status: 'error', error: { message: 'AI cell evaluated but no AI engine configured. Pass an `ai` engine to the QuiltEngine constructor.' } };
   474→            }
   475→            else {
   476→                // Recursively resolve upstream cell values for {{id}} substitution
   477→                const resolved = new Set();
   478→                const resolver = (id) => {
   479→                    if (resolved.has(id))
   480→                        return null;
   481→                    resolved.add(id);
   482→                    const c = this.cells.get(id);
   483→                    if (!c)
   484→                        return null;
   485→                    if (c.value.status === 'ready')
   486→                        return c.value.data;
   487→                    if (c.value.status === 'computing') {
   488→                        // Upstream not yet evaluated — for value cells, evaluate sync
   489→                        if (c.def.kind === 'value') {
   490→                            c.value = evaluateValue(c, ctx);
   491→                            return c.value.data;
   492→                        }
   493→                        return null;
   494→                    }
   495→                    if (c.value.status === 'error')
   496→                        return null;
   497→                    return c.value.data;
   498→                };
   499→                const aiResult = await evaluateAI(cell.def, ctx, this.options.ai, resolver);
   500→                result = {
   501→                    data: aiResult.value,
   502→                    status: aiResult.error ? 'error' : 'ready',
   503→                    error: aiResult.error ? { message: aiResult.error } : undefined,
   504→                    effects: [{ kind: 'model', provider: cell.def.provider || 'unknown' }],
   505→                    computedAt: Date.now(),
   506→                };
   507→            }
   508→        }
   509→        else {
   510→            result = { data: undefined, status: 'error', error: { message: `not effectful: ${cell.def.kind}` } };
   511→        }
   512→        if (this.options.tracing) {
   513→            this.traces.push({
   514→                cellId: cell.id,
   515→                startedAt,
   516→                completedAt: Date.now(),
   517→                durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   518→                context: ctx,
   519→                effects: result.effects,
   520→                error: result.error,
   521→            });
   522→        }
   523→        const prev = cell.value;
   524→        cell.value = result;
   525→        await this.notify(cell.id, result, prev);
   526→        return result;
   527→    }
   528→    /**
   529→     * Recursively refresh formula/value dependencies before computing
   530→     * a formula. This is the "pull" model: we walk down the dep graph
   531→     * and ensure all values are computed.
   532→     */
   533→    async refreshDeps(cell, ctx) {
   534→        for (const depId of cell.dependencies) {
   535→            const dep = this.cells.get(depId);
   536→            if (!dep)
   537→                continue;
   538→            if (dep.def.kind === 'value' && dep.value.status !== 'ready') {
   539→                dep.value = evaluateValue(dep, ctx);
   540→            }
   541→            else if (dep.def.kind === 'formula' && dep.value.status !== 'ready') {
   542→                await this.refreshDeps(dep, ctx);
   543→                const v = evaluateFormula(dep, ctx, this.cells);
   544→                dep.value = v;
   545→                dep.contextCache.set(contextKey(ctx), v);
   546→            }
   547→        }
   548→    }
   549→    /**
   550→     * Propagate a change to all dependents. Mark formula/value
   551→     * dependents as stale and invalidate their cache. Fire listener
   552→     * dependents whose conditions are met.
   553→     *
   554→     * PLAY-TEST ITERATION (SuperInstance play-test, Sep 2026):
   555→     *  - cycle guard: `visited` prevents infinite recursion on cyclic graphs
   556→     *    (previously a set/push on a cyclic sheet recursed forever).
   557→     *  - eager mode (options.eager): stale formula cells are recomputed
   558→     *    DURING propagation, so listeners and subscribers observe fresh
   559→     *    transitions instead of stale data. Prev/new are real, which makes
   560→     *    edge-triggered listener conditions (prev !== current) work.
   561→     */
   562→    async propagate(changedId, ctx, visited, changedPrev) {
   563→        const cell = this.cells.get(changedId);
   564→        if (!cell)
   565→            return;
   566→        const seen = visited ?? new Set();
   567→        if (seen.has(changedId))
   568→            return; // cycle guard
   569→        seen.add(changedId);
   570→        let current = cell.value;
   571→        let prev = changedPrev ?? current;
   572→        // EAGER: recompute a stale formula now so downstream sees fresh values.
   573→        if (this.options.eager && cell.def.kind === 'formula' &&
   574→            (cell.value.status === 'stale' || cell.value.status === 'idle')) {
   575→            prev = cell.value; // the stale value still carries the OLD data
   576→            await this.refreshDeps(cell, ctx);
   577→            current = evaluateFormula(cell, ctx, this.cells);
   578→            cell.value = current;
   579→            await this.notify(cell.id, current, prev);
   580→        }
   581→        for (const depId of cell.dependents) {
   582→            const dep = this.cells.get(depId);
   583→            if (!dep || seen.has(depId))
   584→                continue;
   585→            // PLAY-TEST FIX: also invalidate program/router caches. Previously
   586→            // only formula/value/ai were cleared, so a program cell that declared
   587→            // deps on an upstream cell kept serving its FIRST result forever
   588→            // (e.g. an LLM workflow that never saw new input).
   589→            if (dep.def.kind === 'formula' || dep.def.kind === 'value' || dep.def.kind === 'ai' ||
   590→                dep.def.kind === 'program' || dep.def.kind === 'router') {
   591→                dep.value = { ...dep.value, status: 'stale' };
   592→                dep.contextCache.clear();
   593→            }
   594→            await this.propagate(depId, ctx, seen);
   595→        }
   596→        for (const depId of cell.dependents) {
   597→            const dep = this.cells.get(depId);
   598→            if (!dep || dep.def.kind !== 'listener')
   599→                continue;
   600→            await fireListener(dep, changedId, current, prev, this);
   601→        }
   602→    }
   603→    /**
   604→     * Notify all subscribers of a cell change. Subscriptions can have
   605→     * an optional filter that decides whether to fire.
   606→     */
   607→    async notify(id, value, prev) {
   608→        for (const sub of this.subscriptions.values()) {
   609→            if (sub.cellId !== id)
   610→                continue;
   611→            if (sub.filter && !sub.filter(value, prev))
   612→                continue;
   613→            try {
   614→                await sub.callback(value, prev);
   615→            }
   616→            catch (err) {
   617→                if (process.env.QUILT_DEBUG) {
   618→                    console.error(`[quilt] subscription error for ${id}:`, err);
   619→                }
   620→            }
   621→        }
   622→    }
   623→    /**
   624→     * Add a dependency edge: `from` depends on `to`. Updates both
   625→     * the forward index (from.dependencies) and the reverse index
   626→     * (to.dependents).
   627→     */
   628→    addDep(from, to) {
   629→        const fromCell = this.cells.get(from);
   630→        const toCell = this.cells.get(to);
   631→        if (!fromCell || !toCell)
   632→            return;
   633→        fromCell.dependencies.add(to);
   634→        toCell.dependents.add(from);
   635→    }
   636→    /**
   637→     * Naive auto-detection of formula dependencies: scan the
   638→     * expression for any token that matches a known cell id.
   639→     *
   640→     * Good enough for MVP. A real implementation would parse the
   641→     * expression into an AST and walk it.
   642→     *
   643→     * For AI cells, we scan the prompt, input, and image fields for
   644→     * {{cell.id}} references.
   645→     */
   646→    autoDetectDeps(cell) {
   647→        const fields = [];
   648→        if (cell.def.expr)
   649→            fields.push(cell.def.expr);
   650→        if (cell.def.kind === 'ai') {
   651→            const ai = cell.def;
   652→            if (ai.prompt)
   653→                fields.push(ai.prompt);
   654→            if (ai.input)
   655→                fields.push(ai.input);
   656→            if (ai.image)
   657→                fields.push(ai.image);
   658→        }
   659→        if (fields.length === 0)
   660→            return;
   661→        const text = fields.join(' ');
   662→        const knownIds = new Set(this.cells.keys());
   663→        for (const id of knownIds) {
   664→            if (id === cell.id)
   665→                continue;
   666→            // Match either {{id}} (template) or \bid\b (raw token)
   667→            const reTemplate = new RegExp(`\\{\\{\\s*${escapeRegex(id)}\\s*\\}\\}`);
   668→            const reToken = new RegExp(`\\b${escapeRegex(id)}\\b`);
   669→            if (reTemplate.test(text) || reToken.test(text)) {
   670→                this.addDep(cell.id, id);
   671→            }
   672→        }
   673→    }
   674→}
   675→/**
   676→ * Escape a string for safe use inside a RegExp.
   677→ * Used by `autoDetectDeps` when building patterns to match cell ids.
   678→ */
   679→function escapeRegex(s) {
   680→    return s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
   681→}
   682→//# sourceMappingURL=engine.js.map
